title: WorkerHealth
description: The body of GET /healthz: a worker's liveness/readiness probe and identity. A UI uses `backendUrl` to confirm a worker resolves definitions from, and publishes to, the same backend the UI itself is pointed at; without a match the worker reads as `unverified`.

status.description: Liveness marker; `ok` when the worker is serving.

version.description: The contract version the worker reports (the v0.2.0 milestone), independent of the crate's build version.

role.description: Identifies the service as a worker, distinguishing it from a backend on the same probe shape.

backendUrl.description: The backend this worker resolves definitions from and publishes to (`TCAB_BACKEND_URL`). Always present — a worker requires a configured backend to start.
